ASU.name: Silvio Pettirossi International Airport
ASU.visa_rules_us_citizens: Visa-free for up to 90 days. Must have valid passport with at least 6 months validity. Yellow fever certificate required only if arriving from endemic zones.

climate.december_january: Mid-summer. Hot & humid (34-40C / 93-104F). Frequent afternoon thunderstorms. AC essential.
climate.may_june: Late autumn/early winter. Mild and pleasant (23-26C / 73-79F daytime, 14-16C / 57-61F night). Low humidity. Best time of year to visit.

PTY.name: Tocumen International Airport
PTY.transit_type: Sterile international transit. No transit visa required for US passport holders. Baggage auto-transfers on single ticket.

MIA.name: Miami International Airport
MIA.role: Primary US Gateway to Latin America
MIA.transit_type: Domestic-to-International positioning hub. High flight frequency to South America. Excellent for split-ticketing.
